title: Fixed-G1 inversion: carry merge, tables and retuned blocks

claims.statement: For full-production fixed-G1 pairing inversion, proof.md and referenced evidence give an algorithm returning Q for the exact supplied P with success >=0.39 under H1-H5, H-EA, H-X and H-FFT, at expected total cold work <2^113.059377759038 dense-Fp12 units (C=20000), without amortization. This is expected work, not an every-run bound. The inherited production extrapolations remain material hypotheses. The new carry kernel and full costs are specified in proof.md.

experiments.purpose: Audit costs, success and carry kernel
